derivation: from H6049 (עָנַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has covered;
def: Ananjah, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine

occurrences.text: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
